title: thelypteris alpina
intro: Thelypteris alpina, commonly known as the mountain leather fern, is a species of fern native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris alpina include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
